description: Six sequencer tracks reading one ring of 32 CV knobs, each track with its own clock, play order, start, length and stride

params.text: Picks the order for its track: forwards, backwards, pendulum, a random walk one stride either way, or a random step each clock
Sets where on the ring its track starts, 0 to 31 steps
Sets how many steps its track runs through before starting again, 1 to 32
Sets how many steps its track moves on each clock, 1 to 32
Runs its track; while it is off the track's outputs stay at 0V
Switches its step on or off for one track, and a step that is off gives that track no gate
Sets the voltage of one step of the ring, within the range picked in the menu

inputs.text: Each rising edge moves its track on by its stride
A rising edge sends its track back to the start of its run and blocks that track's clock for 1ms
Sets the offset of its track, 3.2 steps per volt, and overrides the Offset knob while patched
Sets the length of its track, 3.2 steps per volt, and overrides the Length knob while patched
Sets the stride of its track, 3.2 steps per volt, and overrides the Stride knob while patched
Sets its step's voltage from the voltage patched here, overriding both the knob and the poly CV inputs
Sets the voltages of steps 1 to 16, one channel per step, where the step has no cable in its own CV input
Sets the voltages of steps 17 to 32, one channel per step, where the step has no cable in its own CV input
Sets the seed each track's random generator takes on a reset, one channel per track; the seed is the voltage divided by ten and zero gives a fresh run
Runs its track while the voltage here is above 1V and stops it below, overriding the On button

outputs.text: The voltage of the step its track has reached
Passes its track's clock through while the step it has reached is switched on for that track

notes: track 1 comes up switched on and the other five switched off, so only one track plays until their track buttons are pressed
menu: Range — sets the span of the CV knobs; the choices run -3V to 3V, -2V to 2V, -1V to 1V, 0V to 1V and 0V to 2V, and it starts at -2V to 2V
Quantize — rounds every step voltage to the nearest semitone
Hold CV on Rest - Track 1 — holds the last voltage through that track's switched-off steps in place of reading them; the menu carries one such item for each of the six tracks
Randomize CV — gives all 32 knobs new random voltages between -2V and 2V, whatever the Range item is set to
